limitations: Model inputs are authenticated-admission/current-trust observations; no signature or real component release was produced or validated.
manifestDigest/artifactDigests bind explicit synthetic fixture bytes, not a production manifest or executable.
referenceLock output is structural design evidence; production opensip-metadata-canonical.1 serialization/signing remains a security join.
All refusal reasons are model diagnostics to be carried under existing RJ-5 where applicable, not new public refusal codes.
Candidate preference is project-before-global; output comparator is global-before-project per the lead contract.
Provenance/digest comparator ties are tested directly; conflicting admitted tuples are independently rejected before search.
Model-only low visit limits exercise budget arithmetic; production limit remains 100000 visits. Depth 64/65 use the actual production boundary.

V2 rejects all duplicate stableIds within request and duplicate/conflicting IDs across pins plus holds, including the identical pair repeated across lists. Each list is independently sorted by stableId; version is a secondary ordering field that cannot distinguish an allowed duplicate ID because duplicates refuse.
